requirement: The creator-facing card says 'Possible reason · not a diagnosis' and is NEVER a diagnosis, proven root cause, or confirmed explanation

What's actually causing this - the {n} common causes in full

' and build/prerender.js:1325 emits '

Cause {rank}: {name}

'.
